column1: # scripts/gate/suite-ceilings.tsv — per-suite HARD CEILINGS for the CI gate
# (scripts/gate/ci-shard.sh, the hang law). One `dom<TAB>seconds` row per
# suite; every unlisted suite gets the 900 s default. A suite earns a row by
# a MEASURED healthy wall over ~600 s (hosted seconds, run 33148028015's tsv
# or later), never by suspicion — the ceiling is the wedge-stopper, not the
# budget: a listed suite that hangs still dies at ITS row, with slack over
# its honest envelope.
# RE-BASELINED after a hosted gate run under the movie-scaled hosted
# capture profile: fixed-schedule PTY drives legitimately run ~scale× their
# authored seconds on the 2-core runner, so the drive-heavy estates carry
# grants sized from run 2's measured walls plus that stretch. journey was
# tree-killed at 1500 s with every prover completing honestly and one still
# to run (~2000 s whole); diffws at 900 s with prove-cockpit-pointer alone at
# 671 s. The multiplayer row is gone with the multiplayer suite itself (the
# estate retired; a ceiling for a suite that does not exist is dead weight).
# scroll earned its row after a hosted gate run (killed at the 900 default): the
# quiet-box wall at MERCURY_VSHOT_BUDGET_SCALE=3 measured 904 s with
# the engine truly scaling (the wave-5 knob forward), so the hosted 2-core
# run needs the diffws-class slack over that envelope.
